title: MeteoritePlugin
description: MeteoritePlugin is a Paper Minecraft plugin that summons a meteorite at a target location
body:
**MeteoritePlugin** is a Paper Minecraft 1.21.11 plugin that summons a meteorite at a target location. The meteorite flies in from above, leaving a trail of fire, smoke and lava particles, and explodes on impact — dealing damage, applying potion effects (Wither, Weakness, Nausea) and setting nearby players on fire.

**Commands:**
- /meteorite call — strike your own location
- /meteorite call <player> — strike another player
- /meteorite call <x> <y> <z> — strike exact coordinates

Requires the **meteorite.call** permission (operators only by default)
